name: Single-Arm Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
description: The single-arm overhead cable extension uses one hand on a rope or handle attached to a low cable, extending one arm overhead at a time. Training each arm independently allows the lifter to identify and correct strength imbalances between the triceps. The overhead position maximally stretches the long head, and the unilateral loading may allow a greater range of motion and more focused mind-muscle connection.

execution.starting_position: Attach a single handle to a low cable. Face away from the machine. Grab the handle with one hand and bring it behind the head with the elbow bent overhead.
execution.setup_instructions: The free hand can grip the working upper arm for stability or hold the cable for balance.
steps: Step 1: Begin with the working elbow bent, hand behind the head.
Step 2: Extend the elbow overhead until the arm is fully straight.
Step 3: Hold at full extension for one second.
Step 4: Return slowly to the starting bent position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
common_mistakes: Insufficient range of motion at the bottom
safety_considerations: Ensure the elbow points straight up at the starting position
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full elbow flexion with stretch at the bottom to full overhead extension.
coaching_cues: Feel the stretch at the bottom
